source.notes: Genuine school examination paper ('Final Term Examination 2017-2018', Std. VII, Chemistry, Full Marks 80, time blank), hosted on icseboard.org; not a CISCE document. Section A 10+5+5+5+8+7 = 40 confirmed; Section B is 'Answer any four' of six 10-mark questions. Roman numeral 'IV.' is printed twice on page 3; the second (stored as V) is a misprint in the paper. 33 items have chapter null (acids/bases/salts, water, polymers, chemicals in daily life) and are not loaded, so not reviewed. No answer key.
